nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The exchange window opens under the warden seal; any token swaps at full weight, old oak for true wheat, while the crowd counts along; Mab trades her whole tobacco tin for flour, apples, and one bright new sheaf for luck.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='All autumn the mint bell rings clear; new tokens pile in cedar boxes, one minting, one metal, one price; Idris keeps the cracked trial strike on a string as a reminder that money is only a promise kept.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='With Bracken silver flowing again the square settles into one price and easy change; traders from three villages over come to ring the famous true tokens, and Idris earns a stool beside the warden scales.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The recount ends in a feast as long as the tally tables; every counter gets a ribbon and every till gets checked in public; the jubilee becomes a yearly habit, scales and all.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='No names, no shame, just bags on the scale; the amnesty fair refills the market in one bright morning, and Grandmother Mab tells anyone who asks that her tin was the heaviest and proudest of all.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Fenn pins the junior warden badge on with a stern speech about patience, then whispers that Idris did in one market day what seals had failed to do in a season; the scales get a new brass pan.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=95 beats='One steel chip of the master die stays in the pocket of Idris, rubbed smooth as a worry stone; the market heals on its own crooked schedule, and the chip says what the ledgers will not.'>>

ending.title: A Chip of the Master Die

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=95 beats='The court fines Barlo nine buttons and no more; he keeps his brazier, the tokens keep their notches, and his little brass moons become the honest souvenir of a very crooked season.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='Trust thaws slower than frost; for a whole season the square trades in buttons, eggs, and chalk tallies while tokens wait in tins; Barlo prospers wildly and tips Idris a moon of brass for the trouble.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The wardens pay three silver pieces for the drift notebook, and it becomes their teaching book; Idris gets a line in the front in very small print, which somehow feels better than the money.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The boards never go back to one price; wheat stalls and oak stalls glare across the square forever after; Idris can read the drift at a glance now, which feels less like a gift than it should.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=95 beats='Eleven stalls never lift their shutters again; the square stands silent at harvest, prices chalked for customers who went to towns with steadier money; the drift map fades unread on the board.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The strongbox grows heavy and Idris grows quiet; the profits are real, and the looks from the queue are real too; when the mint confesses at last, the partners count their coin in a shuttered stall.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=100 beats='The crowd wants one small neck to blame, and Tamsin is nearest; Rook keeps his desk, the tokens get recast, and Idris learns that a true story told halfway can still hang the wrong person.'>>
